title: Silicon Valley Investor David Sacks Torched Bill Gates Over His Claim That AI Could Kill a Billion People
key_facts: Gates said on NBC's Meet the Press, aired Sunday 27 Sep 2026, that AI is 'certainly powerful enough to drive events that cause a billion deaths'.
Gates urged Congress to pass mandatory federal legislation instead of industry self-regulation, naming no bill.
On 1 Oct 2026 Sacks reposted clips on X attacking the claim.
Sacks is a venture capitalist who stepped down as White House AI czar in the spring and became an external adviser.
One clip quotes Sacks: 'There are no facts or evidence to justify these types of numbers.'
Another asks how Gates will stop Chinese models developing these capabilities.
The piece says the dispute moves no law; regulatory action has yet to take shape.
quote_evidence: There are no facts or evidence to justify these types of numbers.
The question I have for Bill is, how are you going to stop Chinese models from developing these capabilities?
why_it_matters_hint: A public argument over whether extreme risk claims justify binding federal law.
notes: Mostly a retweet exchange; the article's Alphabet share-price commentary was not used.
